source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: colors/github_dark.vim and plugin/github_theme.lua call init.lua, which reads the configuration, loads a palette (palette.lua) then builds the specifications and highlight groups (group.lua and group/modules). The compiler (lib/compiler.lua) caches the result and a lualine theme is provided.
